system.description: You strike the ground with the weight of a falling mountain. Structures within 20' take double damage.

outcomes.success: Every other creature within 20' takes d12 damage, is knocked Prone and is Restrained, buried in debris and mud. A creature can spend ◈ to dig itself out.
outcomes.failure: Half damage, and creatures are knocked Prone but not buried.
outcomes.ruin: The ground gives way under you: you are Prone and Restrained. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
